I don’t have real‑time access to live exchange‑rate data, so I can only give you a rough estimate based on recent averages.

**Approximate conversion (as of early 2026)**  
- 1 USD ≈ 0.77 GBP  
- $20 × 0.77 ≈ £15.40

So $20 is roughly **£15–£16** today.  

Keep in mind that exchange rates fluctuate constantly, so the exact amount you receive will depend on the current rate at the time of your transaction. If you need the precise figure, you can check a reliable financial news site, a bank’s website, or a currency‑conversion app.
